relevance_note: Single case report of a boy with a diagnosis of Blau syndrome in whom no NOD2 variant was found ("It was then concluded that the patient had sporadic BS."); in scope by diagnosis, with his mother as a tested-negative relative.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; no table transcription. The patient has a clinical diagnosis of 'sporadic' Blau syndrome; testing of the child and his mother for 'known genetic mutations associated with BS' was negative, so no variant rows were created (the paper ties no NOD2 variant to anyone; the test method and genes are not stated). The mother is included as a tested relative (negative) with no phenotype information. reports_individuals_with_tnfaip3_variant set true because the patient is an identifiable in-scope person by diagnosis, although he has no NOD2 variant. n_patients_reported left null (authors give no count of NOD2-positive patients; effectively zero). Age at onset recorded as the rash at 2 years (earliest symptom stated); eye symptoms began at presentation at 5 years. Age at diagnosis left not reported: the provisional diagnosis was made during the workup at age 5 but no age at diagnosis is stated. Vital status left not reported (not stated explicitly, though he was followed for 2 years). Systemic hypertension arose after 2 months of infliximab (possibly treatment-related) and is recorded as observed. Normal chest imaging is a whole-investigation normal finding and is recorded as 'abnormal chest imaging' excluded; it is not used to exclude interstitial lung disease. Methotrexate dose printed as '7.5 mg/kg weekly' as written. No internal contradictions found.
